Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. To keep momentum I'll propose a short kickoff plan and two QBR windows so your stakeholders can pick a convenient time.

High-level immediate asks:
- Confirm decision makers for finance/legal and an approximate procurement timeline.
- Share any updated spike/burst forecasts (tokens/day) so Dylan can size GPU configurations.
- Confirm whether you want a 12- or 24-month term (pricing/credit profile attached).

Proposed kickoff timeline:
1) This week — align stakeholders & share SOW draft (we've attached v3).
2) Next week — technical sizing call w/ Dylan (30m).
3) Within two weeks — procurement review and signature runway.

QBR booking windows (pick one):
- Option A: Tue Mar 21, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Thu Mar 23, 14:00–15:00 PT

Attachments: Brightpath_Renewal_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW + pricing), QBR-Agenda-Template.docx

I'll loop Marissa in to coordinate the QBR and shepherd procurement. If those dates look off, suggest two alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks — talk soon.
